warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical LEFT half (the higher-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 6/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 5/21 (2.1 งานหลังคา, RIGHT half) extracted as _1.json.
Item marks ฝ1-ฝ5 (ฝ = ฝ้า/ceiling) are printed in the ลำดับที่ column exactly as shown, matching the mark-prefix convention used for 2.3/2.4's พ/ผ marks on the following sheets.

Each of ฝ1-ฝ4's furring-grid ('โครงเคร่า...') lines is an unnumbered continuation with no leading dash, no quantity or unit printed -- recorded as its own item per spec §11 rather than folded into the preceding row's description.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet, including the 'รวมข้อ 2.2' subtotal row -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the left half (98, 10, 28, 55, 5, 58, 217).
